message.reasoning: We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "Does an export include archived and closed tickets, or only the ones currently in the active queue?" According to DOC-018 part 1: "A standard export from the dashboard includes every record in the current view, including archived and closed ones, unless a filter on the export screen narrows it to a status." So answer: includes archived and closed unless filter narrows. Also mention that export screen filter independent of dashboard view. So answer: yes, includes all records in current view, including archived/closed, unless you set a filter. Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"A standard export pulls every record that’s in the view you’re exporting from – that means archived and closed tickets are included unless you set a filter on the export screen to limit the status. The export screen’s filter is independent of whatever view you had open in the dashboard."}
